title: spex Heritage (wikidata-whs-<date>.json + curation.json)
description: Covers the two real JSON documents crates/spex-heritage produces/reads (docs/FUGEN-ENGINE.md M73): the committed Wikidata World Heritage Site snapshot written by `spex heritage-index` (a JSON array of heritageSite, e.g. scripts/heritage-data/wikidata-whs-2026-08-08.json) and the hand-curated buildability/exclusion file read by `spex heritage-list --buildable` (scripts/heritage-data/curation.json). A document validates against exactly one of the two shapes below.

state_parties.description: Country name(s) as given by Wikidata's own English label (label form, not normalized to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). A real transboundary/serial site lists more than one.

criteria.description: Real UNESCO World Heritage criteria codes. May be empty when Wikidata has no pq:P2614 qualifier recorded for this item — an honest gap, never a fabricated guess.

sites.description: Hand-curated buildability decisions, keyed by Wikidata QID. A QID absent from this map has simply not been reviewed yet -- spex_heritage::is_buildable treats that as not buildable (fails closed), never as an implicit true.

excluded.description: The ethical exclusion list, keyed by Wikidata QID -> a one-line real written reason. Checked independently of (and always overriding) `sites`.

justification.description: A real, specific one-line reason -- not a generic template.
